context.body: Questions about necessities are answered through life, creation, value, and divine care.
context.label: Narrative or literary frame

observations.body: Jesus says not to be anxious about food, drink, body, or clothing and directs attention to birds and lilies.
observations.label: Life, birds, lilies, and little faith answer anxiety: action

observations.body: The Father feeds and clothes; anxiety cannot add to life, and the hearers are called of little faith.
observations.label: Life, birds, lilies, and little faith answer anxiety: response

payload.posture: Read Matthew 6:25–30 as treasure, service, and tomorrow evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: The text names provision without promising that every hearer avoids hunger, loss, or death.
